0022600121.text: The Bulls (1-2, 10th in the East, 1.5 games out of 4th in the Central) visit the Celtics (1-1, 7th in the East, 1.5 games out of 3rd in the Atlantic) for their fourth game of the season, with Chicago coming off a loss and Boston riding a one-game winning streak. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness), and Boston is without Devin Carter (illness). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Bulls lost their 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 124-105 defeat in Boston on February 11.
